question: Which three exact cuisine labels had the highest 2025 Delivered-order GMV in INR? For each label, also give total order count and cancellation rate. Do not split comma-separated cuisine labels.

action.query:
SELECT CUISINE, SUM(DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR, SUM(ORDER_COUNT) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(CANCELLED_ORDER_COUNT) AS TOTAL_CANCELLED_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT) AS TOTAL_DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.MARTS.MART_ORDER_CITY_CURRENCY_DAY_UTC
WHERE ORDER_DATE_UTC >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE_UTC < '2026-01-01' AND CURRENCY = 'INR'
GROUP BY CUISINE
ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC
LIMIT 10;
action.reason: Identify the top three cuisine labels by 2025 delivered GMV in INR, and collect order and cancellation counts for rate calculation. Limiting to 10 in case of ties or nulls; will select top 3 from results.

action.query:
SELECT CUISINE, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DELIVERED THEN SALES_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR,
       COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ORDER_COUNT,
       SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_CANCELLED_ORDER_COUNT
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND CURRENCY = 'INR'
GROUP BY CUISINE
ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC
LIMIT 10;
action.reason: Corrected the query to count orders and cancellations directly, since there is no ORDER_COUNT column in FACT_ORDER. This will allow calculation of cancellation rate for each cuisine.
